title: Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. translated_title: 探索扩散模型与自回归模型中文本到图像Transformer的注意力汇聚现象
translated_abstract: 注意力汇聚是指持续获得与其语义内容不成比例的注意力权重的token或位置。尽管注意力汇聚在大语言模型中已被广泛研究，但其在文本到图像（T2I）Transformer中的行为和功能相关性仍未被充分探索。为填补这一空白并更好地理解文本到图像Transformer如何分配和路由注意力，我们在双向扩散模型和因果自回归模型中探索了这一现象。具体而言，我们探讨了注意力汇聚是否存在、它们出现在何处，以及它们如何从功能上影响生成过程。通过系统性的注意力分析和针对性的干预实验，我们发现注意力汇聚在双向扩散模型和自回归模型中均会出现，但表现出不同的模式。自回归模型将注意力集中于首个token和全局尺度的token，而……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统性地研究了文本到图像Transformer中（涵盖双向扩散模型与因果自回归模型）注意力汇聚现象的存在性、出现位置及其对生成过程的功能性影响，并发现两类模型的注意力汇聚呈现截然不同的模式。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically explores whether, where, and how attention sinks influence generation in text-to-image Transformers across bidirectional diffusion and causal autoregressive models, revealing distinct sink patterns between the two architectures.
